sources.note: Sec. 9.11 (pp. 400-404) is the entire published attestation: sociolinguistic note on c.100 (locally estimated) deaf users, Table 53 of c.32 consistent signs, SOV sign order following spoken Mehek, 'preparatory clause' construction; remarks that signing has much repetition and pointing and that 'facial expressions and eye contact are vitally important'. Nothing on prosody, rhythm, prominence or stress of the sign system; no phonology of the sign language at all.
